title: Jaffa
content_html:
Jaffa

2 Feb 2026

Jaffa was not made of Jaffa cakes
although he did get his name from breaking into a box of them 
he chose us
he was wise and playful
and content and loved
and now he is suddenly gone
because bodies don’t work forever
and we will recognise each other 
and stretch and gently sigh
and sleep peacefully

2010-2026
